title: DigitalHumanities MuseumProvenanceMerge

stats.done_summary:
Successfully completed the Museum Provenance Merge analysis task. The pipeline:

1. Loaded and cleaned 72 raw records from two museum export files (37 from Batch A, 35 from Batch B)
2. Normalized accession numbers by removing hyphens, underscores, and whitespace
3. Parsed temporal information from heterogeneous date formats (years, dynasties, centuries, ranges)
4. Deduplicated records to produce a consolidated catalog of 30 unique objects
5. Generated 5 publication-quality figures showing temporal distribution, era distribution, confidence levels, source comparison, and timeline
6. Produced comprehensive report at report/report.md with methodology, results, and discussion

Key findings:
- 42 duplicate records identified across batches
- Collection spans ~2,500 years (Warring States period to 1998)
- 88.9% CE era objects, 11.1% BCE era objects
- Strong representation from Chinese dynastic periods (Han, Tang, Song, Ming, Qing)

All deliverables complete: code/analyze_provenance.py, outputs/merged_catalog.csv, report/report.md, and 5 figures in report/images/
